summary: Implemented iteration `welcome-email`. Added server-only Gmail SMTP welcome email delivery using `GMAIL_USER`, `GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD`, and `GMAIL_FROM`; added an injectable sender interface for mocked tests; triggered delivery from the Auth.js `createUser` event only after a persisted new user exists; added persisted welcome attempt/sent/status fields to avoid duplicate sends for repeat processing and existing-user logins; and handled missing config, invalid recipients, returned failures, and thrown sender errors without breaking registration. Verification passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd prisma generate --no-engine`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs` with 9/9 passing; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `npm.cmd run build`. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real Gmail delivery were not run per task constraints.
